cards.title: STREET NOTARY
cards.concept: neat street notary in a grey utility jacket over a crisp white shirt, pressing a chunky data-stamp onto a slate tablet held at his chest, cheap earpiece with one tiny cyan LED, calm assured look.
cards.hook: Chief Legal Officer: on any street, the trusted signature everyone lines up for.

cards.title: CAPSULE CONCIERGE
cards.concept: polished capsule-hotel concierge in a grey high-collar uniform jacket and dark tie, holding up a plain white keycard beside his shoulder, wrist display on the raised hand, welcoming smile.
cards.hook: Hospitality is one of the industries where he led financings and restructurings.

cards.title: ARCADE TECHNICIAN
cards.concept: tidy arcade repair tech in a grey work shirt with rolled sleeves, a joystick part held at his chest and a small screwdriver clipped to his collar, focused easy smile.
cards.hook: Gaming is one of the industries he has done deals in, so he knows the machines behind the fun.

cards.title: ASSET TAGGER
cards.concept: data-centre asset tagger in a grey utility vest over a white shirt, holding a bare GPU card at his chest with a handheld tag scanner, one tiny cyan LED on the scanner.
cards.hook: Compute Labs turns GPUs into on-chain assets, and every one first needs its paperwork in order.

cards.title: CONTRACT COURIER
cards.concept: brisk contract courier in a grey hooded techwear jacket over a collared shirt, a slim sealed document case strapped across his chest, earpiece in, confident closed-mouth look.
cards.hook: Led M&A and financings: the deal is only done when the signed papers arrive.

cards.title: SMART CONTRACT AUDITOR
cards.concept: sharp auditor in dark techwear with green-trimmed lapels over a white shirt, a small cyberdeck at his chest glowing with green code bars, a slim silver implant at his temple.
cards.hook: A lawyer in tokenised compute reads smart contracts as closely as paper ones.

cards.title: THE FIXER
cards.concept: cool corpo fixer in a charcoal suit with green-lit lapel pin and white shirt, a compact green-screened phone held up beside his face, a small cyan-lit drone hovering behind his shoulder.
cards.hook: Restructurings are his speciality: fixing companies is literally the job.

cards.title: DEAL DRONE JOCKEY
cards.concept: drone jockey in grey-and-green flight techwear, a green-lit control glove raised near his chest and a small cargo drone carrying a sealed briefcase hovering behind his shoulder.
cards.hook: Led M&A across tech, gaming and hospitality: the deals fly in from every sector.

cards.title: LOOPHOLE HUNTER
cards.concept: lean netrunner in a dark high-collar jacket with green terminal-code piping, a green data cable running from a small temple jack over his shoulder, a green-lit magnifier lens in his hand at his chest.
cards.hook: Chief Legal Officer: he finds the gaps in the terms before anyone else can.

cards.title: SAMURAI ESQ.
cards.concept: street samurai in a sleek armoured suit-jacket with glowing teal seams over a white shirt, the hilt of a teal holo-katana rising behind his shoulder, composed steady gaze.
cards.hook: Esq. is the lawyer's title: a counsel who cuts through bad terms with one clean stroke.

cards.title: BILLION BROKER
cards.concept: elite data broker in a long dark armoured coat with teal-lit seams and a high collar, holding a glowing teal credit shard at his chest, a faint cyan glow on the shard only.
cards.hook: He has led more than $1B in financing.

cards.title: SILICON TRUSTEE
cards.concept: silicon trustee in a sleek teal-seamed long coat with a white shirt and dark tie, one hand in a chrome GPU gauntlet holding up a glowing teal GPU chip near his chest.
cards.hook: At a company that tokenises GPUs, legal is what turns silicon into a trusted asset.

cards.title: MERGER ARCHITECT
cards.concept: chrome-augmented corporate legend in a sharp dark suit with polished chrome shoulder plates, two violet holographic towers joining into one high behind his shoulders, magenta neon edges on the costume.
cards.hook: Led M&A across tech, gaming and hospitality: he builds one company out of two.

cards.title: PHOENIX PROTOCOL
cards.concept: augmented turnaround legend in ornate chrome-and-black armour over a white collar, great magenta and violet phoenix wings made of circuit lines spreading behind his shoulders, a hot-pink core glowing on his chest plate.
cards.hook: Restructurings and business transformation: he brings companies back from the brink.

cards.title: LORD CHANCELLOR OF COMPUTE
cards.concept: ascended chancellor in gold-and-white chrome regalia with a high white collar, a halo of glowing golden GPU cores ringing high behind his side-parted hair, holding a radiant golden contract seal at his chest, calm confident smile.
cards.hook: Chief Legal Officer of tokenised compute: the signature that makes every GPU on the chain binding.
